#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

struct step {
    ll val;
    int cost;
    bool operator>(const step &c) const {
        return cost > c.cost;
    }
};

unordered_set<ll> visited;

bool wasVisited(ll c) {
    return visited.find(c) != visited.end();
}

step uupper(ll n) {
    ll res = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (res < n) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;
        i++;
    }
    return {res, i};
}

step upper(ll n) {
    ll res = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (res * 10 + 1 <= n) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;
        i++;
    }
    ll resmul = res;
    int imul = i;
    while (res < n) {
        res += resmul;
        i += imul;
    }
    return {res, i};
}

step lower(ll n) {
    ll res = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (res * 10 + 1 <= n) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;
        i++;
    }
    ll resmul = res;
    int imul = i;
    while (res + resmul <= n) {
        res += resmul;
        i += imul;
    }
    return {res, i};
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    priority_queue<step, vector<step>, greater<step>> pq;
    pq.push({n, 0});
    while (pq.top().val != 0) {
        ll val = pq.top().val;
        int cost = pq.top().cost;
        pq.pop();
        if (wasVisited(val))
            continue;
        visited.insert(val);

            next.val = abs(val - next.val);
            pq.push(next);
        }
    }
    cout << pq.top().cost << endl;
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

set<ll> visited;

bool wasVisited(ll c) {
    return visited.find(c) != visited.end();
}

void generateSteps(ll n, vector<step>& out) {
    // compute all repunits up to n+1
    vector<ll> reps;
    ll r = 0;
    while (r <= n + 1) {
        r = r * 10 + 1;
        reps.push_back(r);
    }
    // lower
    ll low = 0;
    int lowCost = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)reps.size(); ++i) {
        if (reps[i] <= n) {
            low = reps[i];
            lowCost = i + 1;
        }
    }
    ll res = low;
    int cost = lowCost;
    while (res + low <= n) {
        res += low;
        cost += lowCost;
    }
    out.push_back({res, cost});
    // upper
    res = low;
    cost = lowCost;
    while (res < n) {
        res += low;
        cost += lowCost;
    }
    out.push_back({res, cost});
    // uupper
    ll uu = 0;
    int uuCost = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)reps.size(); ++i) {
        if (reps[i] >= n) {
            uu = reps[i];
            uuCost = i + 1;
            break;
        }
    }
    out.push_back({uu, uuCost});
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    priority_queue<step> pq;
    pq.push({n, 0});
    while (pq.top().val != 0) {
        ll val = pq.top().val;
        int cost = pq.top().cost;
        pq.pop();
        if (wasVisited(val))
            continue;
        visited.insert(val);
        vector<step> steps;
        generateSteps(val, steps);
        for (step next : steps) {
            next.cost += cost;
            next.val = abs(val - next.val);
            pq.push(next);
        }
    }
    cout << pq.top().cost << endl;
    return 0;
}
